reading: Torah, ordinary Shabbat and weekday reading
label: Draft melody, waiting for a cantor’s check
provenance: Every pattern below is a draft. Each one records where it came from in its own "source" field. None was transcribed from a recording or a printed score, and no cantor has checked any of them. To correct a pattern, edit its notes here; when a cantor has approved one, set its "checked" to true and name the cantor in "checkedBy". The app keeps showing the draft label until every pattern is checked.
scale: notes are [semitones above the home note, length in beats]. 0 is the home note (do of a major scale), 2 re, 4 mi, 5 fa, 7 sol, 9 la, 12 the octave; negative numbers lie below the home note.

unmarked.note: A word with no mark of its own (it leans on the next word) is held on one note.
unmarked.source: Convention of this file, not a traditional motif.

mercha.note: Short rise from below into the next stop.
mercha.source: Common North American Ashkenazi Torah tune (the tradition printed in A. W. Binder, Biblical Chant, 1959, and Portnoy and Wolff, The Art of Torah Cantillation, 2000), written out as remembered. Not copied from or compared with a printed source.
